summary:
Complete updated source code for CrediTrack incorporating:
1. Complete Removal of Initial Old Data Fetch: Completely removed the automatic fetching/reading of old data from Google Drive upon Gmail login. Local memory and app dashboard context remain pristine and are never overwritten with outdated sheet values.
2. Strict One-Way Write/Update Sync: Updated the neon 'Sync Now' button to strictly execute a one-way overwrite of the 'CrediTrack_Card_Manager' spreadsheet in Google Drive using current local card configurations and transactions.
3. No Memory Overwriting: Local state is never pulled or overwritten by remote sheet contents during initial login or synchronization.
4. Neon Styling & Charts: Preserved hollow neon chart styling (transparent fills with glowing borders), neon manual sync button with pulse animation, and Android widget controls.
